reasons.SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED: This method needs a supported date range, not the requested scope.
reasons.AMBIGUOUS_SCOPE: Select the activity or test segment.
reasons.NO_MATCHING_ACTIVITY: No activity was found in this range. Check dates or sync.
reasons.MISSING_SIGNAL: Required valid data or independent records are missing. Check the method and evidence requirements.
reasons.QUALITY_REJECTED: Data quality, coverage or fit checks did not pass.
reasons.PROTOCOL_UNKNOWN: Confirm whether this was an actual 30-minute time trial.
reasons.PROTOCOL_UNCONFIRMED: The test protocol is unconfirmed; this is an observation only.
reasons.PROTOCOL_MISMATCH: Ordinary training does not meet this test protocol.
reasons.REFERENCE_REQUIRED: A maximum heart rate reference is needed before adoption.
reasons.REFERENCE_CONFLICT: The estimate conflicts with current reference metrics.
reasons.METHOD_UNAVAILABLE: This method is not available in the product.
reasons.EXECUTION_FAILED: The assessment failed technically. You can retry.
reasons.RESOURCE_LIMIT: This request exceeds the processing limit. Narrow the range.
reasons.NON_CONVERGENCE: The model did not converge reliably.
reasons.STALE: Evidence or settings changed. Reassess before confirming.
